text:
Maya R.: Hi all, Maya here starting in Product today. Trying to finish SSO but Okta hangs at 'Registering passkey' and then shows 'NotAllowedError'. No push or SMS. Anyone seen this?
IT Support: Welcome Maya! Can you confirm device and browser? Also did you try Okta Verify or a passkey?
Maya R.: Personal Linux laptop (Pop!_OS 22.04), Firefox 118. I tried the browser passkey flow from the Okta prompt.
People Ops: Hey Maya, congrats! Tagging infra-bot to check if we need a device-trust exception for non-managed OS. @infra-bot any notes?
infra-bot: Provisioning check: default device-trust policy disallows unrecognized OS. Temporary device-trust lift possible for 12h upon manual request.
Sam (eng): fwiw I had similar on Ubuntu until I enabled WebAuthn in about:config and cleared old passkeys. Might be a conflicting key.
IT Support: Maya, for Linux we sometimes recommend using Okta Verify (mobile OTP) instead of browser passkeys until device is enrolled. I'll open a temp exception and send a one-time SMS code.
Maya R.: Thanks. Error logs from Firefox console when it failed:
```
DOMException: NotAllowedError: User or device conditions prevent the operation
stack: Promise.then
ctx: registerPasskey flow id=xyz-2026
```
IT Support: Got it. Sending SMS code now and enabling temp-device-trust group for 12h. You should get an Okta email in a minute.
onboard-bot: Account provisioning update - Okta: group=temp-device-trust status=pending, GoogleWorkspace: invite_sent, 1Password: seat_queued
Maya R.: SMS received and code accepted! Okta enroll flow completed. Drive access now OK. 1Password still says "seat queued".
IT Support: 1Password seat has been approved, invite resent. Check spam if you don't see it.
Maya R.: Invite arrived and I'm in. All set, thank you everyone :tada:
People Ops: Welcome again, Maya! If you prefer a company laptop, DM me and EM will coordinate device shipment. Also here's the quick-start: https://redwood.com/onboarding/newhire
